scope: Decimal GB, official repository/model files only, excludes Python/PyTorch/runtime/install caches. Read-only metadata and loader-code inspection by model_download_sizes agent.

models.name: IndexTTS2
models.notes: Default script downloads full w2v-bert snapshot, including unused duplicate conformer_shaw.pt; release README says precise synthesis duration control not yet enabled in IndexTTS2 release. Do not conflate later 2.5 duration_factor with IndexTTS2.

models.name: CosyVoice 2 0.5B
models.notes: Standard includes BlankEN initializer, llm, flow, hift, tokenizer, campplus and config. Full directory adds optional batch tokenizer/TensorRT files. Optional ttsfrd not needed by default wetext frontend; packaged ttsfrd wheel is Linux x86_64, not verified macOS.
